_comment: Structural Equal.equals and Hash.hash on plain objects, arrays and Data values walk a service field by field, which keeps nothing (Tim's decision). Under the class rule (a service that reaches class code bails its key; class code is every class body that is not a key class, and every function nested in one) Walked, stored in a `Data.Class` instance (`class Box extends Data.Class {}`), reaches `Data.Class`'s constructor, so its key bails and `equalUnused` stays. Owned reaches no class code: its unread method is removed, and its own [Equal.symbol] and [Hash.symbol], which equality and hashing call, stay (the program's results depend on them).
